title: Binance says its withdrawal recovery work is complete after the October hack
date_note: The Next Web gives only its publication day for Binance's announcement.
geo_basis: no place stated in the source
summary: The Next Web reports that Binance has lifted the last withdrawal limits imposed after its October hack and says its "withdrawal recovery work is complete". It says Binance halted withdrawals after the breach on 29 October, and that a small number of networks remain paused for maintenance or planned upgrades.
plain: Binance says it has finished restoring withdrawals after the October hack. The Next Web says a small number of networks are still paused for maintenance or planned upgrades.
exec: Binance says withdrawal recovery after its October hack is finished, with a few networks still paused for maintenance or upgrades.

validation.note: The Next Web, Cointelegraph and crypto.news each report Binance's 26 Nov statement that withdrawal recovery is complete; Binance's own post was not read.

review.note: Compared title, 29 Oct, paused networks, Thursday 26 Nov date against The Next Web
